name: Yucca schidigera extract
description: Yucca schidigera extract (CAS 223749-05-1 ), also referred to commercially as Yucca Root Leaf Extract, is a plant-derived concentrate obtained from the Mojave yucca plant. It functions primarily as a natural foaming agent, surfactant, and flavor modifier across food, feed, and personal care markets. In animal feed and livestock production, it reduces ammonia and hydrogen sulfide emissions in waste, improving air quality in confined feeding operations. Food and beverage manufacturers use it as a natural foaming agent in root beer, cocktail mixers, and other carbonated beverages. Where stable foam is a product requirement, this extract provides a reliable solution. In pet food formulations, it is incorporated as an odor-control additive that acts within the digestive system to improve the environment for both pets and owners. Personal care formulators apply it in shampoos and cleansing products where natural-origin surfactancy and foam-building properties support clean-label positioning. The extract is supplied as a liquid concentrate, spray-dried powder, and dried flake form to suit different processing requirements. Feed-grade and food-grade specifications are the most commonly stocked, with food-grade material typically conforming to FCC standards. Liquid forms are generally standardized by steroidal saponin content, which is the primary active fraction buyers use to compare supplier grades. This standardization ensures consistency across various batches and applications. Whether used in industrial agriculture or high-end cosmetics, the extract remains a versatile botanical ingredient for modern manufacturing needs.
